title: M3 symmetric raw/delay-corrected PTT reference evaluation / M3 raw 与延迟校正对称 PTT 参考评价
description: Strict evaluation contract for ECG-reference event timing, PPI, HR and coverage. raw and delay_corrected must expose the same scorecard fields so correction cannot hide a degraded metric. / ECG 参考事件定时、PPI、HR 与覆盖率的严格评价合同。raw 与 delay_corrected 必须暴露相同 scorecard 字段，避免延迟校正隐藏退化指标。

schema_version.description: Exact evaluator output schema. / 精确评价器输出 Schema。

evaluation_subject_id.description: Subject evaluated outside the delay-training roster. / 延迟训练名单之外的评价受试者。

delay_artifact_id.description: Exact m3.transit_delay_artifact.v1 identity. / 精确 m3.transit_delay_artifact.v1 标识。

dataset_id.description: M2 external synchronized dataset identity. / M2 外部同步数据集标识。

training_split_id.description: Required split used to fit the delay artifact. / 拟合延迟制品所用的必填划分。

preprocessing_profile_id.description: External PPG mapping profile used before scoring. / 评分前使用的外部 PPG 映射配置。

algorithm_id.description: Frozen symmetric evaluator algorithm ID. / 冻结对称评价算法 ID。

delay_training_subjects_disjoint.description: Leakage assertion enforced at runtime. / 运行时强制的防泄漏断言。

tolerance_ms.description: One-to-one event matching tolerance. / 一对一事件匹配容差。

ppi_error_ms_mae.description: Deprecated alias of delay_corrected.ppi_error_ms_mae. / delay_corrected.ppi_error_ms_mae 的弃用别名。

hr_error_bpm.description: Deprecated alias of delay_corrected.hr_error_bpm. / delay_corrected.hr_error_bpm 的弃用别名。

coverage_fraction.description: Deprecated alias of delay_corrected.coverage_fraction. / delay_corrected.coverage_fraction 的弃用别名。

failure_reason.description: Deprecated alias of delay_corrected.failure_reason. / delay_corrected.failure_reason 的弃用别名。

number_or_null.description: Finite number or null; NaN and infinity are forbidden. / 有限数值或 null；禁止 NaN 与无穷值。

matched.description: One-to-one matched event count. / 一对一匹配事件数。

failure_reason.description: Registered failure reason, or null when at least one event matched. / 已注册失败原因；至少匹配一个事件时为 null。

unit_interval.description: Finite fraction in [0,1]. / [0,1] 内有限比例。
